name: academic-writing-committee
description: Write, review and revise academic documents (books, book chapters, journal and conference papers, surveys, theses, technical reports, grant proposals, lecture notes) to a high standard: a complete writing guide, publication-type profiles, manuscript and citation checkers, and an optional self-improving multi-agent committee of writers, readers, reviewers and editors. With --no-committee it runs as plain single-session academic writing.
